title: CLI dogfood: mid-word judge spans garbled apply; decide duplicates
description:
## Intent

Dogfood of `limatus apply` on a wiki-janitor working copy applied option-3685ce47f53e52da and produced broken prose (`watching.ng hidden from whoever was watching.`) because the judge span ended mid-word (`stayi` | `ng`). `limatus decide` also appends duplicate rows for the same finding_id.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Dogfood CLI rough edges
  Scenario: Mid-word judge spans are dropped
    Given an OpenAI judge finding whose end offset splits a word
    When the judge lane maps findings
    Then that span is not emitted

  Scenario: Decide replaces an existing finding id
    Given a decisions file already containing finding-aaa
    When I run limatus decide for finding-aaa again
    Then the file has one row for that id
    And the draft is unchanged
```

## Also

README has CLI examples but no `from limatus import load_config, diagnose` SDK example (LIM-c32c24 leftover). Add a short SDK snippet in the same PR.

## Out of scope

Published-file apply. Papyrus adapter.

Grok plan. Composer implements. Worktree `/tmp/limatus-LIM-906fc9-dogfood-edges` branch `cursor/feature/LIM-906fc9-dogfood-edges` off origin/main.

1. Drop judge findings whose start/end split an alphanumeric word (`_map_openai_findings`).
2. `record_finding_decision` replaces an existing same finding_id (SDK+CLI).
3. README: short `from limatus import load_config, diagnose` example (closes LIM-c32c24 leftover).
No project/ in PR. No live OpenAI. Unittest + Behave decide replace.
